verdict.rationale: Windmill documents a broad event-trigger system that starts scripts and flows automatically: schedules, webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more. CRON schedules can carry error and recovery handlers, and flow branches add condition-based logic to the actions that run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the event triggers work as documented.
